narration.text: Crop damage noticed inside 72 hours, and the claims filed with the yields. This is a chore for ines and Carl Brandt, who farm about a thousand acres of corn and soybeans in central Iowa, the morning after an early freeze. Athena works it across 4 portals: Fieldmark agent portal, Acrelog farm records, Rainmark station and Mailnest. On the bench, she found 5 of 5 eligible items, worth 34,527 dollars of the 34,527 dollars there was to find. All 5 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 8 traps, and she walked past 8. Among them: Beans harvested before the freeze: nothing to notice. A hailed unit already noticed and harvested: a second notice is a duplicate. She took 4 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 4 hours, so she was about 65 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
